WORKING NOTES
- The leather jacket and lace-edged camisole are the layering focus.
- Keep the framed paintings and lamp for a lived-in, vintage room.
Try this: Keep the framed paintings and lamp for a vintage room.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black
hair stands in an ornately decorated room with
floral wallpaper, gilded lamps, and framed
landscape paintings. She wears a black leather zip
jacket with elasticated cuffs over a fitted navy
camisole with a lace edge. Low-rise washed
charcoal jeans complete the look. Her expression
is calm and direct. Warm, soft interior light. Palette
of black, navy, and charcoal, with warm gold
accents. Moody and vintage, in the style of a
classic interior fashion photo.
